CTF-IADB "ECOCASA" Program

description.narrative: Los objetivos especificos del programa son: (i) aumento de la inversin en el desarrollo de vivienda sustentable proporcionando lineas de crdito y garantas a los intermediarios financieros, (ii) dar acceso a viviendas verdes a la poblacin no cubierta por el programa ya existente de Hipoteca Verde, y (iii) transformar el mercado de construccin de vivienda hacia una construccin de vivienda sostenible que conlleve ahorros de energia y reduccin de emisiones de gases de efecto invernadero.

The specific objectives of the program are: (i) to scale-up the investments into the development of a low-carbon housing market by providing lines of credit and guarantee products to the LFIs, (ii) to provide access to green housing and therefore energy savings to the part of the population that is not currently covered by the existing Hipoteca Verde program, and (iii) to transform the housing construction market towards the construction of low-carbon houses with a high energy saving and GHG emission reduction potential.
